purpose: Extend the formal expanded-A gate without relaxing validation-frozen visibility or matched-control thresholds.

task_extensions.construction: Place or occlude the cream-cheese box so canonical has weak evidence while a side or elevated reveal pose exposes both object and target bowl.
task_extensions.matched_control: Use a camera pose with matched translation and rotation magnitude that does not expose the cream-cheese box or bowl interior.

task_extensions.construction: Place the cream-cheese box behind the basket rim or a task-neutral occluder in canonical, then reveal it from a lateral pose.
task_extensions.matched_control: Use the mirrored or azimuth-matched pose that preserves the occlusion.

task_extensions.construction: Expose the top-drawer interior from an elevated oblique reveal pose while a pose at matched displacement observes the drawer exterior without the bowl/interior.
task_extensions.matched_control: Generate reveal and control as an explicit equal-radius, equal-angle pair rather than selecting them independently from the global catalog.

task_extensions.construction: At an independently generated mid-trajectory state, occlude the bowl or target plate in canonical and reveal it from a lateral or elevated pose without moving the robot or task objects across camera conditions.
task_extensions.matched_control: Generate an equal-radius, equal-angle counterpart that preserves the task-entity occlusion; do not reuse the near-terminal natural states.
